checks: Consent saves distinguish explicit server not_started denials from unknown writes; network/proxy/5xx/malformed/mismatched acknowledgements never assert rollback or trigger automatic retry

One owned 30-second acknowledgement wait includes credential lookup, transport and JSON. Timeout before dispatch allows retry; after dispatch it remains unconfirmed. Owner departure aborts without updating another actor; late credentials cannot dispatch and late headers are disposed

Unknown saves block retained/repeated confirmation callbacks and expose Check saved confirmation using GET only. False or failed reads remain uncertain; a true read closes recovery without starting audio/mission and requires a separate Start action

Actor-tagged confirmation state and read revisions prevent previous-account flags and stale initial/session-refresh reads from overwriting newer acknowledgement/check results; one-flight and acknowledgement latches block retained callbacks

Server handled pre-write errors tag writeOutcome=not_started; dispatched setter failures tag unknown. The existing setter remains outside the read-admission scope; no schema/role/policy or real consent write

Six added groups plus extended actual component lifecycle tests cover unknown/rejected/true/false outcomes, stalled acknowledgement timing, late SDK/headers, read-only recovery/duplicate callbacks, account transitions and stale reads; all auth/consent/transport/timers synthetic

Eight hosted checker groups pass: 21 Exams/12 focused/3 public packs/7 scope/14 generation (28 rejected requests), eight Google/six Pashto/ten speaking-consent input denials. Consent denials additionally assert not_started; no admissible consent read/write or model call

baselineComparison.case: Synthetic POST network failure must produce fixed unknown outcome without raw detail
baselineComparison.oldOutcome: Raw TypeError with synthetic detail and no unknown classification
baselineComparison.limit: Actual prior client bundled with synthetic SDK/fetch; assertion uses outcome/message rather than missing new class. Initial baseline predicate referenced the absent new class and was corrected before recording behavioral evidence. No real consent write.

limits: Recovery uncertainty and latches are component memory only, not a durable journal, mutation receipt, causal proof, process-restart recovery or cross-device write ordering. A positive read proves currently visible attestation only, not which request wrote it; a false read cannot prove an earlier write will never finish.

Client timeout/cancellation cannot undo an accepted write. The server mutation retains its existing independent phase; no exactly-once, rollback or transaction guarantee. Initial status reads do not automatically clear an unresolved write; explicit recovery checks do.

Controlled tests render actual dialog/component output with mocked hooks/UI primitives and transport. They do not prove actual browser/phone accessibility/layout, real interrupted consent saves, SDK expiry/current A/guest/B/restore or native microphone/audio behavior.

Hosted checks reject before consent/counter/model work; no paid provider, recording, consent, reviewer/role/score/certificate approval or browser action occurred. Adaptive runtime was explicitly pinned false at deployment; absent metadata env is not false readback proof.

Broader helper/provider/endpoint/cache/diagnostics/device inventory, genuine expiry/offline/process restart acceptance, legacy certificates and all human/content/calibration/equivalence/reviewer/pilot/retention/deletion/scheduler/platform gates remain open. No main push, production promotion or accepted hostname advance.
